name: BG1.6 chat: the model selector lists the stand-in's models (qwen2.5:7b, llama3:latest) from loke's {"models":[...]}, after the loke router, and none of the static fallback
js: await (async()=>{await window.lokeReady;const sel=document.getElementById('model-select');const want=['loke-router','qwen2.5:7b','llama3:latest'];let got=null;for(let k=0;k<60;k++){got=[...sel.options].map(o=>o.value);if(JSON.stringify(got)===JSON.stringify(want))break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));}const txt=[...sel.options].map(o=>o.textContent);return (JSON.stringify(got)===JSON.stringify(want)&&JSON.stringify(txt)===JSON.stringify(['loke router (auto)','qwen2.5:7b','llama3:latest']))||JSON.stringify({got:got,txt:txt});})()
